meta.title: Conversation search
meta.description: Find text in the current conversation or accessible workspace conversations, with background matching, paged results and verified navigation.

title: Conversation search
openTitle: Find · Ctrl+F / Cmd+F · Also available in the command palette or with a custom shortcut
indexing: Verifying and reading history · {count} text blocks
globalWaiting: Enter a query to scan all conversations
noMatches: No matches in the history read so far
instructions: Choose the current conversation or all conversations, then enter words or code. Archived conversations require the archive option.
locating: Verifying the source and locating the historical message…
handoffTimeout: The target conversation did not open in time. No navigation was performed; open it and try again.
capped: More than 100,000 matches. Only the first 100,000 are retained; refine the query.
globalCapped: The cross-conversation result limit of 5,000 was reached. Scanning stopped; refine the query.
scope: Searches committed user input and assistant text; reasoning is optional. Replies join when committed. Tools, attachments and injected context are excluded. Exact highlighting requires verified source and displayed text.
globalScope: Scans accessible ordinary conversations across all workspaces. Archives are opt-in and archived matches are view-only. At most 5,000 matches are retained per scan. Incomplete reasons remain visible; completion is not a single-time snapshot of all conversations.
unavailable: No conversation is available to search
